learner_facing_text: Completion of this support course is not driver qualification, motor-carrier authority, cargo-securement certification, regulatory inspection authority, or permission to approve a load for public-road transport.
notes: Course terminates at GATE-DRIVER/CARGO. Regulatory responsibility depends on actual vehicle, operation, carrier/driver role and jurisdiction.

learner_facing_text: Federal cargo-securement rules apply to covered commercial motor vehicles and place defined responsibilities on motor carriers and drivers; those rules do not automatically govern every event cart, private-property move, trailer, or helper assignment.
notes: Applicability must be checked before using federal CMV rules as support for learner-facing statements.

learner_facing_text: FMCSA guidance distinguishes who physically performs loading or securement work from the continuing regulatory responsibilities of the covered driver and motor carrier; helper participation does not transfer final regulatory responsibility to the helper.
notes: Role/responsibility architecture only; does not teach cargo-securement methods.

learner_facing_text: A helper may report task completion or visible concerns, but the helper does not convert that report into public-road load acceptance, regulatory inspection signoff, or driver authorization.
notes: Retains the existing learner distinction while avoiding operational securement instruction.

learner_facing_text: Recognizing or practicing with one identified ratchet-strap assembly does not establish cargo-securement system design competence, public-road load acceptance, driver responsibility, lifting/rigging authority, fall-protection authority, towing/recovery authority, or personnel-restraint authority.
notes: Keeps a bounded equipment-familiarization concept separate from regulated cargo responsibility and other hazardous use categories.

learner_facing_text: For covered commercial-motor-vehicle cargo, 49 CFR 393.104 establishes condition and applicable-standard requirements for cargo-securement devices and systems; this regulatory scope is not a substitute for the exact product manufacturer's instructions.
notes: No operational method, ratings calculation or tiedown-selection rule is imported into the matrix from this source.

learner_facing_text: The current model-specific practical sequence must not be treated as release-ready until the exact manufacturer/model instructions and qualified workplace/practitioner review are recorded in the matrix for the actual assembly shown or practiced.
notes: Current course says the manufacturer controls the exact mechanism but the matrix has no named manufacturer/model source. Disposition: needs_model_or_jurisdiction_scope / practitioner review before stronger release.
